text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
The fervor at the Satsuki Sho was something special. 
Kitasan Black, Satono Crown--every time a horsegirl 
appeared, a great cheer went up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it got to her: in the waiting room 
Duramente looked tense. 
When I spoke to her, she did not hear a word.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Like this, she might not manage 
the "running worthy of the strongest" she wants.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
So I brought up the new training menu for after the race. 
She is strong. So there was no need, at this late stage, 
to think up some way to win overwhelmingly.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
And I made her a promise. 
Even during the race, my voice would reach her. 
Duramente told me she would believe that.
